name: rwa-spot-perps-market-monitor
description: Tokenized RWA market monitor — spot scale, venue/issuer competition, perps demand, anomaly detection

scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8025
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && uv run --group dev pytest
scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:revision: cd backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
